title: Switching clouds takes two steps: Disconnect, then Connect the other, so the switch is not one state (S3 PR 3)
evidence: S3 PR 3 (US-25 AC11n, US-54 AC2d amended): CloudSync.switchTo composes Disconnect and connect with no await between them, so CloudConnection gains no state and its table is unchanged (the switchRequested/closing(then:) proposal was dropped). Sync and the welcome sheet at failed show "Switch to <cloud>" rows (Sync/SwitchCloudRow.swift); "Use a different cloud" is retired. Owner D1 (a): a copy-down that cannot reach the cloud with a session open, or an engine throw, stops the switch with the old cloud kept. Owner D2: "Disconnect from <cloud> first, then connect <other>." stays as the race backstop cell. Web wording parity: lead A10. Was: Proposed in the S3 PR 2 design delta: a switchRequested(P) event, then closing with a follow-on P, in CloudConnection (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudConnection.swift refuseAnother). Retires "Disconnect from <cloud> first, then connect <other>." and the welcome sheet's "Use a different cloud" (US-25 AC11l, US-54 AC2d). Changes user-visible flow on both clients: needs web parity (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts prepareSwitch, with lead A9 on the same picker), its own design delta and a UI-thread check of the words
